remarks:
Conveniently located in a desirable Niagara Falls neighborhood, this updated 3+ bedroom Cape Cod offers comfort, flexibility, and an excellent location just minutes from Niagara University. Whether you're looking for a primary residence or an investment opportunity, you'll appreciate the easy access to downtown Niagara Falls, the Village of Lewiston, the Niagara Scenic Parkway, and the Canadian border, placing world-class attractions, dining, shopping, and outdoor recreation all within a short drive.

Inside, the home features a functional and versatile floor plan with a bright living room, kitchen, two first-floor bedrooms, and a full bathroom, making one-floor living a possibility. Upstairs, you'll find a spacious third bedroom along with a bonus room that includes second-floor laundry and offers the flexibility to serve as a fourth bedroom, home office, hobby room, or additional living space.

Outside, the extended driveway provides abundant off-street parking, while the detached one-car garage includes a separate dry storage area for seasonal items, tools, or outdoor equipment. Additional peace of mind comes with the electric service, updated in July 2026.

With its flexible layout, recent updates, and outstanding location near Niagara University, historic Lewiston, the Niagara River, and the world-famous Niagara Falls, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss!
